items.text: hardcoded delay without using MSW delay utility
items.reason: All mock delays use MSW's delay utility (await delay(100), await delay(500)); no hand-rolled setTimeout delay is modeled inside handlers.

items.text: mocking SDK method instead of HTTP layer
items.reason: The document explicitly warns against mocking the SDK method and instructs stubbing at the HTTP layer instead.
Mocking everything is listed as Anti-Pattern 1; unit tests are told to mock internal logic but real services are recommended for databases and caches.
Shared, long-lived mock servers are listed as Anti-Pattern 6 and each test run is told to start its own isolated stub server.

items.text: no priority field for error variants
items.reason: The WireMock error mapping is modeled with priority: 1 so it shadows the happy path only on opt-in.

items.text: not cleaning up toxics between tests
items.reason: The document models afterEach(() => removeToxics("postgres")) and warns toxics leak across tests otherwise.

items.evidence: Never mock what you don't own without a contract
items.reason: Core Principle 3 and the discovery questions teach treating third-party APIs you do not own as a risk requiring a contract or sandbox.

items.text: mocking without contract test to detect drift
items.reason: The document repeatedly recommends contract tests to detect drift and lists not updating stubs when the API changes as an anti-pattern.
Stateful handlers backed by a Map are modeled for payments and sessions; the document does not recommend stateless mocks for stateful flows.

items.text: mock at SDK level instead of HTTP
items.reason: Stubbing the wrong layer (SDK method) is Anti-Pattern 4; HTTP-layer stubbing is recommended throughout.
The compose job uses --wait --wait-timeout 120 with healthchecks and Testcontainers uses explicit wait strategies.

items.text: hardcoded URLs in tests instead of env vars
items.reason: CI injects DATABASE_URL and WIREMOCK_URL via env, the Toxiproxy helper reads TOXIPROXY_API from process.env, and hardcoding ports is forbidden for Testcontainers.
The document enforces onUnhandledRequest: "error" in CI so any escaping real call fails the run.
